    private $createdAt;

    public function __construct($name) {
        $this->name = $name;
        $this->createdAt = new Date();
    }

repeatOutputs.Input:<?php\n$name = \"DevUtils\";\necho:
<?php

class UserCard {
    public $name;
    private $createdAt;

    public function __construct($name) {
        $this->name = $name;
        $this->createdAt = new Date();
    }

    public function greet($times = 1) {
        $message = "";
        foreach ($this->items as $key => $item) {
            $message .= "Hello $item! ";
        }
        return $message;
    }
}

<?php

class UserCard {
    public $name;
    private $createdAt;

    public function __construct($name) {
        $this->name = $name;
        $this->createdAt = new Date();
    }

    public function greet($times = 1) {
        $message = "";
        foreach ($this->items as $key => $item) {
            $message .= "Hello $item! ";
        }
        return $message;
    }
}

class UserCard {
    public $name;
    private $createdAt;

    public function __construct($name) {
        $this->name = $name;
        $this->createdAt = new Date();
    }

    public function greet($times = 1) {
        $message = "";
        foreach ($this->items as $key => $item) {
            $message .= "Hello $item! ";
        }
        return $message;
